title: fix(plugin-auth,app-shell)!: while mail is live, accepting an invitation needs a verified address
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9R6fQuMSzSrRW2oowG4K2kQ)_

Fixes #34272

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/` teaches accepting an invitation or `/organization/accept-invitation`; the rule is stated in the changeset and the self-hosting docs.

> **Governed / Tier H.** A narrowing of an auth route (BREAKING). This PR stays **draft** until `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approve; the seat lands it through Tier H. The area thread does not flip it ready.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：邮件服务可投递（`isConfigured() === true`）时，`POST /organization/accept-invitation` 拒收邮箱未验证的会话：`403 EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED_BEFORE_ACCEPTING_OR_REJECTING_INVITATION`（better-auth 自己的码与句子），什么都不写，邀请仍是 pending。控制台接受页把这个拒绝转到 `/verify-email-prompt`（发验证邮件），验证链接带回接受页。
- **为什么改**：规则是邮件可投递时，接受邀请需要已验证的邮箱，因为未验证的地址不能证明持有受邀邮箱。
- **范围（席位收窄后）**：只动 accept；`get-invitation`、`list-user-invitations`、`reject-invitation` 不变（不写成员）；一步接受门不变（凭证模式先验证再接受，会话模式本来就答 `verify_email`）；**没有可投递邮件的部署完全不变**（那里什么都无法验证地址，拒收等于死路，也是 `requireEmailVerificationOnInvitation: false` 的原因，该声明保留）。
- **风险与回滚**：BREAKING 只落在「邮件可投递 + 未验证地址的人去接受」这一种人身上，修法是先验证邮箱。回滚即还原本 PR：接线只有 `auth-manager-organization-plugin.ts` 里一个 `beforeAcceptInvitation` 钩子 + 两处宿主成员透传。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-accept-verified-email.ts`（规则与为何选 vendor 钩子）；`auth-manager-organization-plugin.ts` 的 `beforeAcceptInvitation`；`ui/.../AcceptInvitationPage.tsx` 的 `handleAccept`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/invitation-accept-verified-email.test.ts`，预期 14 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：作为受管（Tier H）收窄，按 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 批准；其余席位落地。

## What changes

**Rule.** While the deployment's mail transport is live, an invitation is accepted only by a session whose address is verified. Without a live transport nothing changes.

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-accept-verified-email.ts` (new): `refuseUnverifiedAcceptWhileMailIsLive(user, { isEmailDeliveryLive, verificationRequired? })`, a no-op for a verified user (it does not even ask whether mail is live) and while mail is not live; otherwise it throws `APIError.from('FORBIDDEN', …)` with the vendor's own `$ERROR_CODES` entry (a local fallback is pinned equal to the vendor's). The verified test is the vendor's own (`!user.emailVerified`).
- `auth-manager-organization-plugin.ts`: the rule is asked from better-auth's `organizationHooks.beforeAcceptInvitation`, which the vendor fires inside the accept endpoint after its not-found / expiry / status, recipient and membership-limit checks and before the invitation row or the membership is written, handing it the `session.user` its own session middleware resolved (cookie and bearer alike). The `requireEmailVerificationOnInvitation: false` comment now says why it stays false and where the live-mail rule lives.
- `auth-manager.ts`, `auth-manager-plugin-list.ts`: `isEmailDeliveryLive` passed through the two typed hosts to the organization plugin.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/.../AcceptInvitationPage.tsx`: on that code, navigate to `/verify-email-prompt?email=<account email>&redirect=<this page>` instead of a toast. `orgErrorMessage.ts` exports the code and `isAcceptNeedsVerifiedEmail(err)` (read by code only).
- `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`: one paragraph under the `invite_only` sign-up paragraph.
- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-error-vocabulary.ts`: one `foreign-vocabulary` row classifying the vendor code, beside the sibling row for `EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED_FOR_INVITATION` (`check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`).
- `.changeset/34272-accept-invitation-verified-email.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@objectstack/runtime` patch (`Metadata-protocol: none` takes patch; the BREAKING banner stays); BREAKING, Who moves, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

No spec, schema, stored row, route or exported signature of a published entry changes. No new error code is minted (the vendor's), so nothing reaches the error-code ledger.

### Why the vendor hook and not the global before-hook

The seat's correction named "a plugin-auth before-hook". `beforeAcceptInvitation` is that, at the vendor's own seam: the global `hooks.before` runs before `bearer()` turns a bearer credential into a session (so it would need a second session read and a user read), and it would answer ahead of the vendor's recipient check, telling a non-recipient about someone else's address. The vendor hook gets the exact user object the vendor's own verification check reads, after the recipient check, before any write.

### Why not turn the vendor option on where mail is live

`requireEmailVerificationOnInvitation` governs accept, reject and get-invitation together (`crud-invites.mjs:270/382/505`, better-auth 1.7.12) and is read from options at boot. The narrowing the seat ruled is accept only, asked per request.

## Tests

`src/invitation-accept-verified-email.test.ts` — real `AuthManager` + real better-auth pipeline over the memory engine (the `list-user-invitations-verification.test.ts` shape); the email service's `isConfigured()` is swapped between requests; every fixture account is asserted unverified.

1. the local fallback equals the vendor's `$ERROR_CODES` entry;
2. PREMISE: with the option false and no live mail, the vendor lets an unverified invitee accept;
3. mail live: unverified invitee → 403 with the vendor's code, no membership, invitation still pending;
4. mail live: a bearer-token session is refused alike;
5. mail live: once the address is verified, the same invitation is accepted;
6. ORDER PIN: a non-recipient still gets `YOU_ARE_NOT_THE_RECIPIENT_OF_THE_INVITATION`;
7. ONLY ACCEPT: the same unverified invitee still gets, lists and rejects (200);
8. mail live: the one-step door still accepts with the mail's proof (it verifies first);
9. no email service: unverified invitee accepts (unchanged);
10. log transport (`isConfigured()` false): unverified invitee accepts (unchanged);
11. read per request: live → 403, log → 200, live again → 403;
12–14. the function: verified passes without asking; unverified passes while not live; unverified / unknown user refused while live, with the entry the caller hands in.

`ui/.../__tests__/acceptInvitationVerifiedEmail-34272.test.tsx` — the real `createAuthClient` over a stubbed `fetch` answering the server's 403 body: the page navigates to `/verify-email-prompt` with the account's email and `redirect=/accept-invitation/inv-1`, no toast, no org switch; CONTROL: `YOU_ARE_NOT_THE_RECIPIENT_OF_THE_INVITATION` still toasts and does not navigate there.

**Ablation.** The hook body made a no-op on disk: tests 3, 4, 5 and 11 red (4 of 14), then restored. The page's routing branch disabled: the UI routing test red (1 of 2), then restored.

## Verification

Final head `8e828209b5ce1d69a9c3513e319dce15eaa58101`. Measured at `b2d54a28` (final-head comment 6940567054); `8e828209` changes prose only (the changeset, the module's header comment and the self-hosting paragraph, after L1 6940626667), and the 41 derived gates over docs, changesets and ADR text plus `plugin-auth` typecheck and the module's 14 pins re-ran green on it.

- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 111 families; all 111 ran, each with its exit code captured, and all ended exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 111 accounted, 111 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Four first-run reds were fixed or were prerequisites: `check:adr-0087-registration` (the changeset's `FROM → TO` label read as a migration prescription; reworded to prose), `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` (the vendor code needed its classification row, added), and `spec check:docs` / `spec check:skill-examples` (stale `packages/spec` build; green after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`).
- **Package suites.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` exit 0; `ui`: `vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0 (after building its workspace dependencies, whose stale `dist` predated #34333).
- **Ablation.** As above: 4 of 14 server pins and 1 of 2 UI pins red with the change removed, restored after.
- **Dogfood battery** (narrowing): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, no `OS_TEST_SHARD`, at `b2d54a28` (the code at `8e828209` is the same; only prose moved): `Test Files 478 passed | 3 skipped (481)`, `Tests 4055 passed | 68 skipped (4123)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **merge-tree** at the head: clean against `origin/main` `fecd2e95d4`, which now holds #34617 (the other plugin-auth change in flight at opening).
